description: Draft audience-specific handoff copy from public Cassie context, optionally grounded in claim_id. Returns copy and a suggested canonical action only; it does not save, send, publish or contact anyone. No login required. Use get_verified_recommendation for reader-fit recommendations.

audience_mode.description: Required audience from the listed enum; selects the framing for a draft only, not a destination or recipient.

claim_id.description: Optional public claim ID to ground the handoff in a specific claim.
